Uwasa no Midori-kun!! ( うわさの翠くん!! ; lit. ' The Rumored Midori-kun!!

[ edit ]
The manga was adapted into a Nintendo DS game called Uwasa no Midori-kun!! Natsu Iro Striker ( うわさの翠くん!! 夏色ストライカー ) , which was released by Idea Factory on September 20, 2007. Drama CD

Based on the manga, a Drama CD , called Uwasa no Midori-kun!! Futari no Oji to Hadaka Hime no Fukushu , was released on March 5, 2008, by Sony Music Entertainment . The songs are sung by Hikaru Midorikawa , Akira Ishida , Romi Park and Kazuya Nakai . [ 6 ]

HEROINE: Yamate Midori — 15-year-old tomboy from an island who, after a betrayal, disguises herself as a boy to enroll at Aoba 3rd High School (all-boys high) and play soccer; a dormmate discovers her gender almost immediately [1].

THE "CHILDCHILDHOOD FRIEND" — NAME & WHAT HE DID: He is Hino Tsukasa (17, 2nd year at Jōsei High; the manga calls him her first love, not a lifelong childhood friend — minor discrepancy with the user's framing: he's the boy who vacationed on her island and taught her soccer, not a raised-alongside friend [1][2]). After they reunite, Tsukasa bets with his teammates that he can seduce her; on their first date he convinces her to give up her virginity (which she'd been saving for her future husband) with the promise they will marry; the next day she learns it was a bet, and he mocks her as an easy "country girl" and tells her she should be proud to have been intimate with a future soccer star [1]. Midori develops feelings for Kazuma, lets go of Tsukasa, confesses, they begin dating; he proposes after graduation, they marry and have a daughter (Akane) on Midori's island; in the epilogue Tsukasa appears married to another woman with a son, Kakeru [1].

MATURE/SEXUAL CONTENT — CATALOGED: Yes, the manga portrays sexual content: the bet-driven virginity/seduction scene, and Tsukasa "constantly harasses her sexually when they are alone" [1].
